scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -

scripts.speaker: Rare Poison Herb Collector
scripts.text: I wander around the world and collect rare poison herbs. Recently, I started dealing in the herb called Izidor. If you are interested, you can buy them.
Exchange it for a Bitter Herb
Exchange it for a Deadly Noxious Herb
Exchange it for a Frozen Rose

scripts.speaker: Rare Poison Herb Collector
scripts.text: You can buy them for 10,000 zeny and one of these rare items, Animal Blood, Bitter Herb, Deadly Noxious Herb, Frozen Rose, Ment or an Hinalle.

scripts.speaker: Rare Poison Herb Collector
scripts.text: Why do I ask money? That's just to pay a little respect to a collector like me. Ha ha ha...

scripts.speaker: Rare Poison Herb Collector
scripts.text:
How many do you want?
You can only buy a maximum of '2000' ea.
Enter '0' if you want to cancel.

scripts.speaker: Rare Poison Herb Collector
scripts.text: The number must be less than 2,000!

scripts.speaker: Rare Poison Herb Collector
scripts.text: Hey, come back when you have all the requirements for the exchange.

scripts.speaker: Rare Poison Herb Collector
scripts.text: Good. I've received the money and the special item.

scripts.speaker: Rare Poison Herb Collector
scripts.text: I wander around the world and collect rare poison herbs. But I don't feel like selling my herbs to a person like you... ha ha ha...
